sources.scope_as_recorded: Publicly reported Q2 2026 inpatient unit average daily patient-to-staff ratios plus ED/PACU daily staff and patient summaries for two New Brunswick general hospitals; quarter ending June 30, 2026.
limits_as_recorded: Report quarter is 2026 Q2 (ended June 30, 2026); not live staffing.
NJDOH explicitly cautions that reports should not be used to compare hospitals or state averages because patient needs, policy and layout differ.
